note: Reviewed Liquipedia team name -> FACEIT org/team. Keys are the folded Liquipedia name, or 'name|na' / 'name|emea' when the same name is two teams in two regions; entity_type is 'org' (entity_id is the org slug) or 'team' (an unmapped FACEIT team id). The reconciler trusts these and only these without marking a link provisional. Edit by hand or with `python -m owcsmuse liquipedia teams decide`.
